scope: Availability/provenance observation only. No external likelihood is considered reproduced until RLL materializes immutable inputs and reproduces an official reference execution.

observed_facts: DESI publishes DR2 cosmology chains and posterior-maximization products for the March 2025 cosmology results.

An official DESI Data Q&A states that the historical desi_y3_cosmo_bindings desi_bao_all likelihood is identical to the released Cobaya bao.desi_dr2.desi_bao_all likelihood and that the measurement/covariance files are byte-identical.
This observation removes 'product unavailable' as a generic blocker for the BAO likelihood path but does not prove that RLL has materialized, hashed or reproduced the official likelihood.
DESI_DR2.required_next_action: Materialize the current official Cobaya DESI DR2 BAO likelihood/data in a clean pinned environment, freeze package/data hashes and reproduce official LCDM/CPL reference values before any RLL comparison.

observed_facts: DES publishes the Y6 3x2pt cosmology result and analysis-methodology papers.
The official DES page states that some Y6 cosmology data products have been released and more are forthcoming.

This audit has not yet established an immutable RLL-local custody path for the complete executable 3x2pt likelihood, covariance, nuisance priors and scale-cut configuration needed for reference reproduction.
DES_Y6_3X2PT.required_next_action: Inventory the official Y6A2 release and associated analysis repository/package, identify the exact executable 3x2pt likelihood/data/covariance/nuisance configuration used by the published result, then materialize and reproduce its reference cosmology.
